name: The Snug
factsSource: Checked October 4, 2026. Sources: Bing Places (via Web IQ); the band Worst Case Scenario's show list (wcsrocks.com), which lists acoustic sets at The Snug in Wantagh; instagram.com, irloc.com, x.com, en.wikipedia.org.
reviewNotes:
Small Irish pub near the Wantagh train station with acoustic sets. Research the dance floor.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Open; Nassau County. No website (the Google listing uses the Facebook page as its website). Dance floor: none found; it is a small neighborhood pub. Two other Facebook pages ('The Snug Wantagh', id 100093071125732, and 'The SNUG', id 100083284753569) also showed up in search; not verified and not used. The Instagram bio and a Wantagh Chamber listing give a second phone number that public people-search sites tie to a private person's mobile, so it is not recorded. No logo or photos: no website, Facebook/Instagram images need a login, and Facebook's picture endpoint is blocked by robots.txt. Hours are from the Google listing; the Instagram bio's opening times agree.
hours: Mon-Thu 3 PM-2 AM; Fri 3 PM-3 AM; Sat 12 PM-3 AM; Sun 12 PM-2 AM
description: A small, cozy Irish bar near the Wantagh train station, with outdoor seating. It serves drinks and light pub food and has live music on some nights, often acoustic sets.

evidence.note: Google listing: The Snug (bar), 1941 Wantagh Ave, Wantagh NY 11793, (516) 804-0276, weekly hours, 'Live performances' and outdoor seating; its website is this Facebook page and its profiles are Facebook and Instagram.
Instagram @the_snug_wantagh bio (seen in search results): 'The Snug Bar and Lounge', 1941 Wantagh Ave, Wantagh NY; opens 3 PM Mon-Fri and 12 PM Sat-Sun.
IRLOC: 'WCS Unplugged' at The SNUG, Fri Oct 9 at 6 PM, is described as 'Worst Case Scenario unplugged' - an acoustic set by a band, not a West Coast Swing night.
Worst Case Scenario NY (@wcs_rocks) calls itself a Long Island rock cover band (classic rock, 80s-10s, country), which explains the WCS name.
